m: 1. सू (not separable in all forms fr. √ 2. सू; cf. 1. सु-षू, असु-सू, and √ 4. सु) cl. 6. P. (Dhātup. xxviii, 115) सुवति (in Br. also ˚ते, and accord. to Dhātup. xxii, 43 and xxiv, 32 also सवति and -सौति; pf. सुषुवे, AV.; p. सुषुवाण, q.v.; aor. असावीत्, साविषत्, RV. : Pass. सूयते, Br. &c.), to set in motion, urge, impel, vivify, create, produce, RV. &c. &c.; to hurl upon, Bhaṭṭ.; to grant, bestow (esp. said of Savitṛ), RV.; to appoint or consecrate to (Ā. ‘to let one's self be consecrated’), AV.; TS.; to allow, authorize, ŚBr. : Intens. सोषवीति, to urge or impel violently (said of Savitṛ), RV.

2. सू (cf. 1. सू and √ 5. सु) cl. 2. Ā. (Dhātup. xxiv, 21) सूते (1. sg. pr. सुवे, 3. sg. impf. असूत; in later language also सूयते [xxvi, 31] and in comp. with प्र also -सवति and -सौति [cf. xxiv, 31]; pf. ससूव, RV.; सुषुवे, AV. &c.; सुसाव, MBh. &c.; aor. असुषोत्, MaitrS.; ˚षवुः, TBr.; असोष्ट, ChUp.; असौषीत् and असविष्ट Gr.; fut. सोता, सविता, ib.; सोष्यति, ˚ते, Br. &c.; सविष्यति, ˚ते, MBh. &c.; p. f. सूष्यन्ती, RV.; सोष्यन्ती [s.v.] ŚBr. ; inf. सूतवे, RV.; सूतवै, AV.; सवितवे, ib.; सोतुम् or सवितुम् Gr.; ind.p. सूत्वा, Br.; -सूय, MBh. &c.; -सुत्य, ŚBr.), to beget, procreate, bring forth, bear, produce, yield, RV. &c. &c.: Pass. सूयते (aor. असावि), to be begotten or brought forth, MBh.; Kāv. &c.: Caus. सावयति Gr.: Desid. सुसूषति, ib.
3. सू mfn. begetting, procreating, bringing forth, producing (mostly ifc.; see अ-, अम्भः-, कर्ण-सू &c.)
सू m. one who begets, a father, RV.; VS.
a mother, RV. i, 32, 9
child-bearing, parturition, W.
सू [cf. Gk. ὗς, σῦς; Lat. sus; Angl.Sax. sû; Eng. sow; Germ. Sau.]
4. सू ind., Ved. and in some comp. = सु, well, good &c. (cf. सू-नर, सू-नृत &c.)
a: सू — {vI.v} {c2c} {c4c} A. (सूते, सूयते, सूत) To bring forth, produce, beget, yield (fig. also); असूत सा नागवधूपभोग्यं Ku. 1. 20; कीर्ति सूते दुष्कृतं या हिनास्ति U. 5. 31. --WITH प्र to bring forth, beget, produce. {vII.v} {c6c} P. (सुवति) 1 To excite, incite, impel. --2 To remit (as debt).
सू — a. (At the end of comp.) Bringing forth, producing, yielding &c. --f. 1 Birth. --2 A mother.

m: सू-भर्व mfn. (for सु + भ्˚ fr. √ भर्व्) eating or feeding well (as a bull; others ‘well nourished’, fr. √ भृ), RV.
सूखर m. pl. N. of a Śaiva sect, W.

सूच् (rather Nom. fr. सूच and सूचि below) cl. 10. P. (Dhātup. xxxv, 21) सूचयति, to point out, indicate, show, manifest, reveal, betray (in dram. = ‘to indicate by gesture, communicate by signs, represent’), MaitrUp.; MBh.; Kāv. &c.; to trace out, ascertain, espy, MW. : Pass. सूच्यते (aor. असूचि), to be pointed out or indicated, Kāv.; Kathās. &c.: Intens. सोसूच्यते, Pat. on Pāṇ. iii, 1, 22.
a: सूच् — {c10c} U. (सूचयति-ते, सूचित) 1 To pierce. --2 To point out, indicate, show, manifest, prove; त्वां सूचयिष्यति तु माल्यसमुद्भ बोयं (गंधः) Mk. 1. 35; Me. 21; Ś. 1. 14. --3 To betray, divulge, reveal; स जातु सेव्यमानोऽपि गुप्तद्वारो न सूच्यते R. 17. 50. --4 To hint, intimate, suggest. --5 To gesticulate, act, indicate by gestures or signs; वामाक्षिस्पंदनं सूचयति, रथवेगं सूचयति &c. --6 To trace out, spy, ascertain. --WITH अभि to {{show, indiate->show, indicate||20210104|Dr. Sampada Savardekar and Jim Funderburk|https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/20|}}; अमन्यत नलं प्राप्तं कर्मचेष्टाभिसूचितं Mb.

m: सूचि or सूची, f. (prob. to be connected with सूत्र, स्यूत &c. fr. √ सिव्, ‘to sew’, cf. सूक्ष्म; in R. once सूचिना instr.), a needle or any sharp-pointed instrument (e.g. ‘a needle used in surgery’, ‘a magnet’ &c.), RV. &c. &c.; the sharp point or tip of anything or any pointed object, Kāv.; Car.; BhP.; a rail or balustrade, Divyāv.; a small door-bolt, L.; ‘sharp file or column’, a kind of military array (accord. to Kull. on Mn. vii, 187, ‘placing the sharpest and most active soldiers in front’), Mn.; MBh.; Kām.; an index, table of contents (in books printed in India; cf. -पत्त्र below); a triangle formed by the sides of a trapezium produced till they meet, Col.; a cone, pyramid, ib.; (in astron.) the earth's disc in computing eclipses (or ‘the corrected diameter of the earth’), Sūryas.; gesticulation, dramatic action, L.; a kind of coitus, L.; sight, seeing (= दृष्टि), L.; m. [सूच्-इन् वा ङीप्] 1 Piercing, perforating. --2 A needle --3 Sharp point or pointed blade (as of Kuśa grass); अभिनवकुशसूच्या परिक्षतं मे चरणं Ś. 1; so मुखे कुशसूचिविद्धे Ś. 4. 13. --4 The sharp point or tip of anything; कः करं प्रसारयेत् पन्नगरत्नसूचये Ku. 5. 43. --5 The point of a bud. --6 A kind of military array, a sharp column or file; दंडव्यूहेन तन्मार्गं यायात्तु शकटेन वा . वराहमकराभ्यां वा सूच्या वा गरुडेन वा Ms. 7. 187. --7 A triangle formed by the sides of a trapezium produced till they meet. --8 A cone, pyramid. --9 Indication by gesture, communicating by sings, gesticulation. --10 A particular mode of dancing. --11 Dramatic action. --12 An index, a table of contents. --13 A list, catalogue. --14 The earth's disc in computing eclipses (in astr.). --Comp. --अग्र a. needle-pointed, having a sharp needle-like point, acuminated. --(ग्रं) the point of a needle. --आस्यः a rat. --कटाहन्यायः see under न्याय. --खातः a sharp pyramid or pyramidal excavation, a cone. --पत्रकं an index, a table of contents. --(कः) a kind of potherb. --पुष्पः the Ketaka tree. --भिन्न a. bursting open at the points of the buds; पांडुच्छायोपवनवृतयः केतकैः सूचिभिन्नैः Me. 23. --भेद्य a. {1} to be pierced or penetrated by a needle. {2} thick, dense, pitchy, gross, utter; रुद्धालोके नरपतिपथे सूचिभेद्यैस्तमोभिः Me. 37. {3} palpable, tangible. --मुख a. {1} needle-mouthed, having a pointed beak. {2} pointed. --(खः) {1} a bird. {2} white Kuśa grass. {3} a particular position of the hands. --(खं) a diamond. --रोमन् m. a hog. --वदन a. needle-faced, having a pointed beak. --(नः) {1} a gnat, mosquito. {2} a mungoose. --शालिः a kind of fine rice.

s: puM, OzaDaviSezaH । yaTA, -- “vizaM palamitaM sUtaH SARakaScUrRayeddvayam । taccUrRaM saMpuwe kftvA kAcaliptaSarAvayoH ॥ mudrAM kftvATa saMSozya tataScullyAM niveSayet । vahniM SanEH SanEH kuryyAt praharadvayasaNKyayA ॥ tataH udGAwya tanmudrAmuparisTaSarAvakAt । salagnI yo BavedDUmastaM gfhRIyAcCanEH SanEH ॥ vAyusparSI yaTA na syAttataH kUpyAM niveSayet । yAvat sUcyA muKe lagnaM kUpyA niryAti Bezajam tAvanmAtro raso deyo mUrcCite satipAtini ॥ kzureRa pakzate mUrdDni tatrANgulyA ca Garzayet ॥ raktaBezajasamparkAt mUrcCito'pi hi jIvati । taTEva sarpadazwo'pi mftAvasTo'pi jIvati । yadA tApo Bavettasya maDuraM tatra dIyate ॥” iti sUcikABaraRo rasaH ॥ iti BEzajyaratnAvalI ॥ * ॥ api ca । “vizaM palaM rasa SARaM taccUrRaM kAcalepite । mftsaMpawe ca saMruDya callyAM saMsTApya pAcayet ॥ SanEryyAmadvayaM paktvA taM samudvAsya SItalam । UrdDapAtragataM DUmaM gfhItvA spfzwamArutam ॥ yAvat sUcyA muKe lagnaM kUpyA AyAti Bezajam kzureRa prakzate SIrze tatrANgulyA ca Garzayet ॥ tridoze mUrcCito jIvo raktaBezajasaNgamAt । sarpadazwo mftAvasTaH so'pi jIvati tatkzaRAt dadyAcca maDuraM toyaM sUcikABaraRe rase ॥” iti sUcikABaraRarasaH sannipAte ॥ iti rasapradIpaH ॥ * ॥ (api ca । “rasaganDakanAgaYca vizaM sTAvarajaNgamam । mAtsyavArAhamAyUracCAgapittErviBAvayet ॥ sUcikABaraRo nAma BEraveRa prakIttitaH । sUcikAgreRa dAtavyaH sannipAtanivarhaRaH ॥” iti sUcikABaraRo rasaH ॥ iti vEdyakarasendrasArasaMgrahe jvarADikAre ॥)
v: na॰ vEdyakokte OzaDaBede tatpAkAdi yaTA “vizaM palamitaM sUtaH SARakaScUrRayed dvayam । taccUrRaM saMpuwe kftvA kAcaliptaSarAvayoH । mudrAM kftvATa saMSozya tataScUllyAM niveSayet । vahniM SanEH SanEH kuryyAt praharadvayasaNKyayA । tata udGAwya tanmudrAmuparisTaSarAvakAt । saMlagno yo BavedDUmastaM gfhRIyAcCanEH SanEH । vAyusparSo yaTA na syAttataH kUyAM niveSayet । yAvat sUcyA muKe lagnaM kUpyA niryAti Bezajam । tAvanmAtro raso debo mUrcCite sannipAtini । kzureRa prakzate mUrDni tatrANgulyA ca Garzayet । raktaBezajasamparkAt mUrcCito'pi hi jIvati । taTEva sarpadazwo'pi mftAvasTo'pi jIvati । yadA tApo Bavettasya maDuraM tatra dIyate” BEzajyaratnA॰ । “vizaM pala rasaM SARaM taccUrRaM kAcalepite । mftsaMpuwe ca saMruDya cUdDyAM saMsTApya pAcayet । SanEryAmadvayaM paktA taM sasudvAsya SItalam । UrDvapAtragataM DUmaM gfhItvA'smfzwa mArutam । yAvat sUcyA muKe lagnaM kUpyA AyAni Bezajam । kzureRa prakzate SIrze tatrANgalyA ca Garzayet । tridoze mUrcCito sIbo raktaBezajasaNgamAt । sarpadazwo mftAvasTaH so'pi jIvati tatkzaRAt । dadyAcca maDuraM toyaM sUcikABaraRe rase” iti rasapradIpaH ।

a: सूक्ष्म — a. [सूच्-मन् सुक् च नेट्; Uṇ. 4. 176] 1 Subtle, minute, atomic; जालांतरस्थसूर्यांशौ यत्सूक्ष्मं ट्टश्यते रजः. --2 Little, small; इदमुपहितसूक्ष्मग्रंथिना स्कंधदेशे Ś. 1. 19; R. 18. 49. --3 Fine, thin, delicate, exquisite. --4 Nice. --5 Sharp, acute, penetrating. --6 Crafty, artful, subtle, ingenious. --7 Exact, precise, accurate, correct. --क्ष्मः 1 An atom. --2 The clearing-nut plant. --3 An epithet of Śiva. --क्ष्मं 1 The subtle all-pervading spirit, the Supreme Soul. --2 Minuteness. --3 One of the three kinds of power attainable by an ascetic; cf. सावद्य. --4 Craft, ingenuity. --5 Fraud, cheating. --6 Fine thread &c. --7 N. of a figure of speech, thus defined by Mammaṭa: --कुतोऽपि लक्षितः सूक्ष्मोप्यर्थोन्यस्मै प्रकाश्यते . धर्मेण केनचिद्यत्र तत्सूक्ष्मं परिचक्षते K. P. 10. --Comp. --आत्मन् m. N. of Śiva. --एला small cardamoms. --तंडुलः the poppy. --तंडुला {1} long pepper. {2} a kind of grass. --दर्शिता quick-sightedness, acuteness, foresight, wisdom. --दर्शिन्, --दृष्टि a. {1} sharp-sighted, eagleeyed. {2} of acute discernment. {3} acute, sharp-minded. --दारु n. a thin plank of wood, a board. --देहः --शरीरं the subtile body which is invested by the grosser material frame (= लिंगशरीर q. v.). --पत्रः {1} coriander seed. {2} a kind of wild cumin. {3} a sort of red sugar-cane. {4} the gum Arabic tree. {5} a sort of mustard. --पर्णी a kind of basil. --पिप्पली wild pepper. --बीजः the poppy. --बुद्धि a. sharp-witted, acute, shrewd, intelligent. (--द्धिः f.) sharp wit, acute intellect, mental acumen. --मक्षिकं, का a mosquito, gnat. --मानं a nice or exact measurement, precise computation (opp. स्थूलमान which means ‘broad measurement,’ ‘rough calculation). --शर्करा small gravel, sand. --शालिः a kind of fine rice. --षट्चरणः a sort of louse.

सूर्य m. the sun or its deity (in the Veda the name Sūrya is generally distinguished from Savitṛ [q.v.], and denotes the most concrete of the solar gods, whose connection with the luminary is always present to the poet's mind ; in Nir. vii, 5 he is regarded as one of the original Vedic triad, his place being in the sky, while that of Agni is on the earth, and that of Indra is in the atmosphere; ten hymns in the RV. are entirely in praise of Sūrya, e.g. i, 50, i, 115 &c., also, AV. xiii, 2; he moves through the sky in a chariot drawn by seven ruddy horses or mares [see सप्ताश्व, हरित्, हरिद्-अश्व]; in the later mythology Sūrya is identified with Savitṛ as one of the 12 Ādityas or emblems of the Sun in the 12 months of the year, and his seven-horsed chariot is said to be driven by Aruṇa or the Dawn as its charioteer, who is represented without legs; the Sun, whether named Sūrya or Vivasvat, has several wives See सूर्या below), RV. &c. &c. (cf. IW. 11; 16 &c.; RTL. 341)
a symbolical expression for the number ‘twelve’ (in allusion to the sun in the 12 signs of the zodiac), Jyot.; Hcat.
the swallow-wort (either Calotropis or Asclepias Gigantea, = अर्क), L.

a: सूर्यः — [सरति आकाशे सूर्यः, यद्वा सुवति कर्मणि लोकं प्रेरयति; cf. Sk. on P. III. 1. 114] 1 The sun; सूर्ये तपत्यावरणाय ट्टष्टेः कल्पेत लोकस्य कथं तमिस्रा R. 5. 13. [In mythology, the sun is regarded as a son of Kaśyapa and Aditi; cf. Ś. 7. 20. He is represented as moving in a chariot drawn by seven horses, with Aruṇa for his charioteer. He is also represented as all-seeing, the constant beholder of the good and bad deeds of mortals. Saṃjñā (or Chāyā or Aśvinī) was his principal wife, by whom he had Yama and Yamunā, the two Aśvins and Saturn. He is also described as having been the father of Manu Vaivasvata, the founder of the solar race of kings,]. --2 The tree called Arka. --3 The number ‘twelve’ (derived from the twelve forms of the sun). --4 The swallow-wort. --5 N. of Śiva. --Comp. --अपायः sunset; sUtamanaGaM nEmizIyA maharzayaH । purARasaMhitAM puRyAM papracCa lomaharzaRam ॥ tvayA sUta mahAbudDe BagavAn brahmavittamaH । itihAsapurARArTaM vyAsaH samyagupAsitaH ॥ asya te sarvvaromARi vacasA hfzitAni yat । dvEpAyanasya BagavAMstato vE romaharzaRaH ॥ Bavantameva BagavAn vyAjahAra svayaM praBuH । munInAM saMhitAM vaktuM vyAsaH pOrARikIM purA tvaM hi svAyamBuve yajYe satyAdO vitate sati । saMBUtaH saMhitAM vaktuM svAMSena puruzottama ॥” iti kOrmme । 1 । 3 -- 6 ॥ * ॥ api ca । “niyogAdbrahmaRaH sArdDaM devendreRa mahOjasaH । veRaputtrasya vitate purA pEtAmahe maKe ॥ sUtaH pOrARiko jajYe mAyArUpaH svayaM hariH । pravaktA sarvvaSAstrARAM DarmmajYo guRavatsalaH ॥ taM mAM vitta muniSrezWAH pUrvvodBUtaM sanAtanam । etasminnantare vyAsaH kfzRadvEpAyanaH svayam ॥ SrAvayAmAsa yAH prItyA purARapuruzo hariH । madanvaye ca ye sUtAH saMBUtA vedavarjjitAH । tezAM purARavaktftvaM vfttirAsIdajAjYayA ॥” iti kOrmme 12 aDyAyaH ॥ * ॥ kiYca । “brahmaRaH pOzkare yajYe sUtyAhe vitate sati । pfzadAjyAt samutpannaH sUtaH pIrARiko dvijaH ॥ vaktA vedAdiSAstrARAM trikAlAmalatattvavit । tIrTayAtrAprasaNgena nEmizAraRyamAgamat ॥” iti vahnipurARe 1 aDyAyaH ॥ * ॥ anyacca । “haste tu dakziRe cakraM dfzwvA tasya pitAmahaH । vizRoraMSaM pfTuM matvA paritozaM paraM yayO ॥ 44 ॥ tasya vE jAtamAtrasya yajYe pEtAmahe SuBe । sUtaH sUtyAM samutpannaH sOtye'hani mahAmate ॥ 50 tasminneva mahAyajYe jajYe prAjYo'Ta mAgaDaH । proktO tadA munivarEstAvuBO sUtamAgaDO ॥ 51 stUyatAmeva nfpatiH pfTurvERyaH pratApavAn ॥” 52 iti vizRupurARe । 1 । 13 aDyAyaH ॥ * ॥ yUna eva pfTorjAtatvAt jAtamAtrasya yajYa ityucyate । pfTurevABavat yasmAttataH pfTurajAyata iti mAtsyokteH । pEtAmahe pitAmahadEvatye pfToreva yajYe na tu pitAmahakarttfke । yaTAha vAyuH । vERyasya hi pfToryajYe varttamAne mahAtmanaH । sUtaH sUtyAM samutpanna iti । sUtyAmiti sUtiraBizUtiH aBizUyate kaRqyate somo'syAmiti sUtiH sImABizavaBUmistasyAm । sOtye'hani tasminneva dine । iti tawwIkA ॥ * ॥ kiYca । “etasminneva kAle tu yajYe pEtAmahe SuBe । sUtaH sUtyAM samutpannaH sOtye'hani purARavit ॥ tezAM yajYe punastvevamutpannO sUtamAgaDO । pfToH stavArTaM tO tatra samAhUtO maharziBiH ॥ te UcurfzayaH sarvve stUyatAmeza pArTivaH । tErniyuktO sukarmmARi pfToryAni mahAtmanaH ॥ tuzwuvustAni sarvvARi ASIrvvAdAMstataH parAn tayoH stavAnte supItaH pfTuH prAdAt janejvaraH ॥ anUpaMdeSaM sUtAya mAgaDAn mAgaDAya ca । taM dfzwvA paramapItAH prajAH prAhurmaharzayaH ॥ vfttInAmeza vo dAtA Bavizyati nareSvaraH ॥” iti vahnipurARe pfTorupAKyAnanAmADyAyaH ॥

3. सूत m. (of doubtful derivation, prob. to be connected with √ 1. सू; for 1. 2. सूत See pp. 1239 and 1240) a charioteer, driver, groom, equerry, master of the horse (esp. an attendant on a king who in earlier literature is often mentioned together with the ग्राम-णी; in the epics also a royal herald or bard, whose business was to proclaim the heroic actions of the king and his ancestors, while he drove his chariot to battle, or on state occasions, and who had therefore to know by heart portions of the epic poems and ancient ballads; he is the son of a Kṣatriya by a Brāhmaṇī or of a Brāhman [accord. to Śāśvata also of a Śūdra] and a Kṣatriyā; the most celebrated Sūta was Loma-harṣaṇa who was a pupil of Vyāsa), AV. &c. &c. (IW. 510 n.)

k.v: आधोरणा हस्तिपका हस्त्यारोहा निषादिनः। नियन्ता प्राजिता यन्ता सूतः क्षत्ता च सारथिः॥
सर्वं च तैजसं लौहं विकारस्त्वयसः कुशी। क्षारः काचोऽथ चपलो रसः सूतश्च पारदे॥

विष्णावप्यजिताव्यक्तौ सूतस्त्वष्टरि सारथौ। व्यक्तः प्राज्ञेऽपि दृष्टान्तावुभौ शास्त्रनिदर्शने॥

v: na॰ sUtikAyA nivAsayogyamagAram । mUtikAgfhe arizwe । sUtikAgfhAdayo'pyatra । tatkaraRapraveSamuhUrttAdikaM pIyU॰ uktaM yaTA “uktaYca SrIpatinA “punarvasO ca sUtikAgfhasya nirmitiH SuBA । viraYcivizRu BAntare praveSanaM hitaM Bavet” iti । viraYciraBijinnakzatram antare maDye viraYcivizRutArayorityeva saptamyA aDikaraRatve voDite antarapadoktiH spazwArTA । tadetatbrAhmaRavyatiriktavarRatrayavizayam । yadAha lallaH “punarvasO nfpAdInAM karttavyaM sUtikAgfham । SravaRABijitormaDye praveSaM tatra kArayet” iti । AvaSyakatve tu SravaRABijitormuhUrttastadudayo grAhyaH vA ityarTaH । brAhmaRasya tu prAguktanakzatrezveva sUtikAgfhanirmARapraveSO tatra sUtikAgfhaM nErftyAM kAryyam । yadAha vfdDavasizWaH “EndryAM tu vikramasTAnamAgneyyAM pacanAlayaH । vAruRyAM BojanagfhaM nErftyAM sUtikAgfham । yAmyAyAM SayanasTAnaM vAyavyAM paSumandiram । kOveryyAM tu DanasTAnam ESAnyAM devatAlayaH” iti । smftiBAskare gargaH “vAre'nukUle rASO tu dine dozavivarjite । sAnukUladiSi proktaM sUtikABavanaM vuDEH” iti । kAlAniyaBa ukto ratnakoSe “Asannaprasave mAsi kuryyAccEva viSezataH । tadvat prasavakAle syAditi SAstrezu niScayaH” iti । varAheRAtrAnekanakzatrARAmaBiDAnaM kftaM yaTA “hastAdityaSaSANkatizyapavanaprAjyeSamitrottarAcitrASviSravaRezu vfScikaGawO hitvA virikte tiTO । SukrAcAryyaSanE ScarajYa SaSinAM vAre'nukUle viDO sadrarveSmani sUtikA gfhaviDiH kzemaNkaraH kIrtyate” iti । veSmani caturTasTAne sadBiH SuBagrahEH । sUtikAgfhapraveSe kAlaviSezamAha jyotirvaSizWaH “aTAtaH sampravakzyAmi sUtikAgAraveSanam । mAse tu navame prApte pUrvapakze SuBe dine । prasUtisamBave kAle sadya eva praveSayet” iti । pUrvapakze Suklapakze nakzatrAdInyAha gargaH “rohiRyEndavapOzRezu svAtIvAruRayorapi । puzye punarvasO hastaDanizWA tryuttarAsu ca” iti । “mEtratvAzwre taTASvinyAM sUtikAgAraveSanam । sarve SuBagrahAH kendre pApASca trizaqAyagAH । SuBASe SuBasaMdfzwO sUtikAgAraveSanamiti” । tadAkAramAha BAvapra॰ “azwahastAyataM cAru caturhastaviSAlakam । prAcIdvAramudagdvAraM vidaDyAt sUtikAgfham” ।

a short sentence or aphoristic rule, and any work or manual consisting of strings of such rules hanging together like threads (these Sūtra works form manuals of teaching in ritual, philosophy, grammar &c.: e.g. in ritual there are first the Śrauta-sūtras, and among them the Kalpa-sūtras, founded directly on Śruti q.v.; they form a kind of rubric to Vedic ceremonial, giving concise rules for the performance of every kind of sacrifice [IW. 146 &c.]; other kinds of Ś˚ works are the Gṛhya-sūtras and Sāmayācārika or Dharma-sūtras i.e. ‘rules for domestic ceremonies and conventional customs’, sometimes called collectively Smārta-sūtras [as founded on स्मृति or ‘tradition’, see स्मार्त]; these led to the later Dharmaśāstras or ‘law-books’ [IW. 145]; in philosophy each system has its regular text-book of aphorisms written in Sūtras by its supposed founder [IW. 60 &c.]; in Vyākaraṇa or grammar there are the celebrated Sūtras of Pāṇini in eight books, which are the groundwork of a vast grammatical literature; with Buddhists, Pāśupatas &c. the term Sūtra is applied to original text books as opp. to explanatory works; with Jainas they form part of the Dṛṣṭivāda), IW. 162 &c.
a kind of tree, Divyāv.
a: सूत्रं — [सूत्र्-अच्] 1 A thread, string, line, cord; पुष्पमालानुषंगेण सूत्रं शिरसि धार्यते Subhāṣ.; मणौ वज्रसमुत्कीर्णे सूत्रस्येवास्ति मे गातिः R. 1. 4. --2 A fibre; सुरांगना कर्षति खंडिताग्रात्सूत्रं मृणालादिव राजहंसी V. 1. 18, Ku. 1. 40. --3 A wire. --4 A collection of threads. --5 The sacred thread or sacrificial cord worn by members of the first three classes; शिखासूत्रवान् ब्राह्मणः Tarka K. --6 The string or wire of a puppet. --7 A short rule or precept, an aphorism. --8 A short or concise technical sentence used as a memorial rule; it is thus defined: --स्वल्पाक्षरमसंदिग्धं सारवद्विश्वतोमुखम् . अस्तोभमनवद्यं च सूत्रं सूत्रविदो विदुः. --9 Any work or manual containing such aphoristic rules; e. g. मानवकल्पसूत्र, आपस्तंबसूत्र, गृह्यसूत्र &c. --10 A rule, canon, decree (in law). --Comp. --आत्मन् a. having the nature of a string or thread. (--m.) the soul. --आली a string of beads &c. worn round the neck, a necklace. --कंठः {1} a Brāhmaṇa. {2} a pigeon, dove. {3} a wag-tail. --कर्मन् n. carpentry. --कारः, --कृत् m. an author or composer of Sūtras. --कोणः, कोणकः a small drum shaped like an hourglass (डमरु). --गंडिका a kind of stick used by weavers in spinning threads. --चरणं N. of a class of charanas or Vedic schools which introduced various Sūtra works. --तंतुः a thread, string. --तर्कुटी a distaff, spindle. --दरिद्र a. ‘poor in threads’, having a small number of threads, thread-bare; अयं पटः सूत्रदरिद्रतां गतः Mk. 2. 9. --धरः, --धारः {1} ‘the thread-holder’, a stage-manager, the principal actor who arranges the cast of characters and instructs them, and takes a prominent part in the Prastāvanā or prelude; he is thus defined. --नाट्यस्य यदनुष्ठानं तत्सूत्रं स्यात्सबीजकम् . रंगदैवतपूजाकृत् सूत्रधार इति स्मृतः ... {2} a carpenter, an artisan. {3} the author of a set of aphorisms. {4} an epithet of Indra. --पिटकः N. of one of the three collections of Buddhistic writings. --पुष्पः the cotton plant. --भिद् m. a tailor. --भृत् m. = सूत्रधार q. v. --यंत्रं {1} ‘a thread machine’, shuttle. {2} a weaver's loom. --वीणा a kind of lute. --वेष्टनं a weaver's shuttle.
